decisions.notes: Faceted low poly brown hen with red comb and wattles, raised tail feathers and yellow feet. Intentional low-poly style: glTF validation clean (0 errors), faceted flat-shaded mesh at ~3k triangles with a single texture. Grab3D ships these as 'Lightweight' companions to the high-detail animals. Scoring reflects the deliberate low-poly aesthetic: clean silhouette and complete animal, but flat-shaded materials and minimal topology rather than PBR.
limitations: AI-assisted origin is disclosed upstream (origin.ai_content); some storefronts require an AI-content disclosure when you resell.
Deliberately low-detail (~3k triangles, flat-shaded, single texture) for mobile/stylised use; not PBR.
Unrigged static mesh with baked pose.
